summary: Mimimi's Edo-period stealth tactics line, centered on Blades of the Shogun and the stand-alone Aiko's Choice expansion.

entries.title: Shadow Tactics: Blades of the Shogun
entries.definitive_edition: Current Windows PC release plus Aiko's Choice as a separate stand-alone expansion

primary.why: Windows has the original PC release, mouse/keyboard tactics controls, broad storefront access, and the most flexible capture/settings route; later console versions add convenience but no exclusive content.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC version for the main archive run, then play Aiko's Choice separately for the stand-alone expansion story.

entries.remaster_caveats: Later PS5/Switch 2 versions are ports/upgrades, not content-expanded definitive editions.

entries.title: Shadow Tactics: Blades of the Shogun - Aiko's Choice

primary.why: Aiko's Choice launched as a stand-alone PC expansion and Windows remains the highest-fidelity, most flexible capture route; later PS5/Xbox Series/Switch 2 ports add convenience but no exclusive content.
primary.how_to_play: Play Aiko's Choice on Windows after the main Shadow Tactics campaign, since it takes place within that story and assumes familiarity with the characters.

entries.remaster_caveats: Aiko's Choice is a stand-alone expansion, not a sequel or remaster.
